answer: Audits are recorded in yarrow, queued in summit, and terrace publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 23 identities per epoch. A farm of 199 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2160 identities would post 4954 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
